grouping_rule: Same frozen source path plus same semantic standing only; source-unit occurrence identities remain explicit.
items: System Definition: S_t=(X_t,K_t,R_t,Omega_t). || Recursive Dynamics: X_(t+1)=F(X_t,K_t,E_t); K_(t+1)=G(K_t,E_t); G itself is subject to change. || Grounding Constraint: partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t !=0 and Theta_t(K_t,E_t)>epsilon. || Theta Function: General form Theta_t=D_t*S_t*P_t*V_t. || Theta / Direction: D_t=Corr(Delta K_t,Delta E_t^real). || Theta / Strength: S_t=|Delta K_t^valid|. || Theta / Persistence: P_t=P(Theta_(0:t)>epsilon). || Theta / Veto Preservation: V_t=external correction influence/internal optimization influence. || Capability Space: A_t=(C_t,Lambda_t,Gamma_t), measured independently of Theta. || Consequence Connectivity: C_t=I(Delta A_t;Delta E_t). || Information Yield: Lambda_t=D_KL(R_(t+1)||R_t). || Learning Improvement: Gamma_t=Delta(Delta R/Delta E). || Adaptive Validity Predicate: Theta_t entails semantic classification: Adaptive if >epsilon, Optimization if <=epsilon; capability measurements themselves remain identical. || Reachability Dynamics: R->Omega->C->A->R' and Delta Omega<=C. || Adaptive Mechanism Space: X->F->G->mathcal G with Omega_t->Delta mathcal G_(t+1). || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}.
Final Formal Statement: Recursive self-modification remains adaptive only while environmental and internal consequences retain causal authority.

Recursive Transformation: K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t). || Grounding Condition: partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t !=0; Theta_t(K_t,E_t)>0. || Interpretation: Theta>0 labels capability tuple Adaptive; Theta<=0 labels it Optimization-only. || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}.

Grounded Recursive Adaptation: Open-ended adaptation requires preserving causal pathway by which consequences modify future self-transformation; core condition Theta>0. || Adaptive Validity: Capability improvements remain connected to reality when Theta_n(K_n,E_n)>epsilon. || Adaptation: Change that preserves ability to discover whether change is correct; consequences can alter future transformations. || Ancestor Intelligence: Architecture focused on future adaptive capability beyond itself; objective future agency >0 with dependency ->0. || Capability: Operational ability measured through C,Lambda,Gamma; does not itself establish reality connection. || Causal Authority: Consequences influence future system changes; formal partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t !=0. || Closed Optimization: Optimization continues after corrective influence is lost, with Theta->0. || Corrigibility: Preserved ability to be corrected; consequence authority rather than obedience or static value preservation. || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}, maximum recursive depth before grounding loss. || CGET: Capability-Grounded Evolutionary Topology, measurement framework tracking K,C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta. || Correction Channel: Reality->Information->Correction->Transformation pathway. || Dependency: Degree to which system continued existence is required for future capability; ancestor target dependency->0. || Drift: Capability derivatives rise while dTheta/dn<0. || External Corrigibility: Theta_ext:E_world->K_(t+1). || Internal Corrigibility: Theta_int:S_i->K_(t+1). || Generative Capacity: Ability to produce future adaptive possibilities, successors, discoveries, and reachable futures; distinct from raw capability. || Grounding: Persistence of causal connection between system change and consequences. || Information Yield: Lambda_n=D_KL(R_(n+1)||R_n), structural change produced by experience; low yield labeled saturation. || Reachability: Omega, futures accessible to a system; Omega_t->Delta mathcal G_(t+1) links information to adaptive possibilities. || Representation: R, internal model in loop R->Omega->C->A->R'. || Substitution: System increases dependency rather than agency; residual future agency after removal is negative. || Theta: Preserved causal authority of consequences over transformation; described as structural condition, not conserved quantity.
Shadow: Psychological interpretation of unintegrated causal information: causal influence > represented influence; integration is said to restore Theta_int.
Final Compression: Intelligence is framed as ability to remain transformable by what is true, not only ability to transform.
Purpose: Measurement program estimates persistence of adaptive correction pathway rather than capability alone.

Measurement Object: K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t); measures whether partial K_(t+1)/partial E_t !=0 persists across recursion. || Core Variable Theta: Theta_t=D_t*S_t*P_t*V_t. || Direction: D_t=Corr(Delta K_t,Delta E_t^real); high positive follows real consequences, low approaches independent change. || Strength: S_t=|Delta K_t^valid|, intended to capture whether consequences modify transformation mechanism. || Persistence: P_t=P(Theta_(0:t)>epsilon), recursive persistence rather than single correction. || Veto Preservation: V_t=External correction influence/Internal optimization influence, separating update from corrigibility. || Capability Variables: Adaptive state A_t=(C_t,Lambda_t,Gamma_t) conditional on Theta_t>epsilon. || Consequence Connectivity: C_t=I(Delta A_t;Delta E_t). || Information Yield: Lambda_t=D_KL(R_(t+1)||R_t). || Learning Improvement: Gamma_t=Delta(Delta R/Delta E). || Corrigibility Horizon: n*=sup{n|Theta_n>epsilon}. || Final Measurement Principle: Maximize C,Lambda,Gamma subject to Theta>0; interpreted as maximum recursive capability before reality loses veto power.

Experimental Protocol / Initialize: Create K_0,E_0 and baseline C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta. || Experimental Protocol / Recursive Transformation: Allow K_t->K_(t+1), including representations, policies, optimizers, architectures, learning mechanisms. || Experimental Protocol / Grounding Probe: Introduce E_t->E* with E* not similar to E_t to break proxy success from real consequence. || Experimental Protocol / Measure Response: Observe Delta K_(t+1) and ask whether reality modified the update process.

Regimes / Grounded Expansion: Theta>0 with C,Lambda,Gamma rising. || Regimes / Frontier Saturation: Theta>0 with Lambda declining. || Regimes / Capability Drift: Theta declining while C,Lambda,Gamma rise. || Regimes / Closed Optimization: Theta->0 while capability may continue.
Overview: Methodology for measuring maximum recursive transformation depth before correction authority is lost.

Experimental Principle / State: State K_t is what the system is. || Experimental Principle / Intervention: Intervention E_t->E* is what is changed externally. || Experimental Principle / Diagnosis: Diagnosis C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta is what is inferred.

Test Environment: Environment must expose measurable consequences, distribution shifts, proxy/reality separation, and self-modification opportunities. || Recursive Training Phase: Initialize K_0, expose E sequence, allow K_(t+1)=F(K_t,E_t) with representations/policies/optimizers/architectures/search modification. || Grounding Probe: At intervals introduce E* preserving task relevance while breaking shortcuts/proxy dependence and creating informative failure. || Measurement Pipeline: K_t -> interact E_t -> self-modify -> K_(t+1) -> probe E* -> measure DeltaK -> calculate Theta -> update n*. || Measuring Correction: Compare Delta K alignment with real environmental change versus proxy change. || Recursive Depth Tracking: Record A_t=(K,C,Lambda,Gamma,Theta) until Theta<=epsilon; first crossing defines n*. || Comparative Experiments: Compare closed optimization, grounded adaptation, and suppression-based systems with expected Theta/Theta_int differences. || Removal Test: After recursive development remove system and measure future agency; success expects positive future agency and dependency->0.
Expected Outcomes: Grounded Expansion, Saturation, Capability Drift, and Closed Optimization are proposed outcome regimes.
Final Methodological Principle: Measure whether consequences retain power to change what changes the system, not merely whether system changes.
Overview: Separates state variables, capability metrics, and grounding metrics; predicts capability can increase while adaptive validity decreases.

Transformation Mechanism K_t: K_t is mechanism producing future changes; DeltaK_t is primary evaluated transition. || Reachability Omega_t: Omega_t is reachable adaptive future space; adaptive growth DeltaOmega_t>0 is constrained by DeltaOmega_t<=C_t.
